records.title: Robot Learning Engineer (m/f/d) VLA & Foundation Models
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: A relevant degree OR an equivalent combination of research and professional experience in robot learning/embodied AI is essential.
records.context: Python and PyTorch implementation beyond notebooks is essential. RL and simulation/sim-to-real are listed as beneficial, while practical learned policies and robot integration are essential.
records.output: Develop vision/language-conditioned manipulation policies; collect and validate multimodal demonstrations; define action/control interfaces; diagnose distribution-shift, contact, latency and sensing failures; integrate runtime monitoring and fallbacks.

records.title: Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d) VLA Training & Evaluation
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: Relevant degree, with Master’s/PhD described as typical, OR equivalent formal training plus demonstrated deep-learning training experience.
records.context: PyTorch OR JAX training internals; reproducible evaluations; imitation-policy understanding. Real-robot evaluation and sim-to-real familiarity are beneficial.
records.output: Build reusable VLA fine-tuning and evaluation workflows, generalization benchmarks, experiment/checkpoint tracking and ablations; test whether more realistic simulation improves hardware outcomes.

records.title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: PhD with RL focus OR equivalent RL research-and-robotics-deployment record; alternatively a relevant Master’s from a top-tier technical university plus 5+ professional years. Preserve the alternatives.
records.context: Robot-control fundamentals, Python/PyTorch, working C++, simulation, domain randomization and reward shaping; shipping and maintaining field models.
records.output: Own motion-policy training infrastructure and transfer into industrial legged-robot deployment; improve robustness from locomotion field failures and maintain the Python/C++ stack.

records.title: Research Engineer - New Grad (2027)
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: Full source specifies MSc/PhD in ML/computer vision with autonomy/robotics applications or closely related field, graduating Dec 2026 or Summer 2027. Also specifies 1+ year of experience in any field OR equivalent education and experience. Both automated clause arrays are empty.
records.context: Hands-on experience in at least one listed topic group, including world/action/foundation models, VLA post-training/RL, or physics-aware reconstruction/simulation. Not all listed topics are simultaneous requirements.
records.output: Early-career research on end-to-end autonomy and robotic generalists, with deployment and publication collaboration.

records.title: Robot Learning Engineer - Manipulation
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: Source lists Bachelor’s in CS/Software Engineering or equivalent and 1+ professional year. Intro explicitly values demonstrated real-system work including equivalent practical experience over degree/title. Both automated clause arrays are empty.
records.context: Deployed and evaluated a learned manipulation policy on a physical robot; Python/PyTorch; imitation learning and at least one modern policy family; kinematics/frames/calibration. RL post-training is nice-to-have.
records.output: Own manipulation task definition, demonstrations, data curation, policy fine-tuning, on-robot evaluation and edge deployment for industrial work; measure success rate, cycle time, interventions and time/data to target.

records.title: Research Scientist
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: PhD preferred OR Master’s in CS/Robotics with significant publication record, plus 5+ years of AI/robotics research including physical deployment. Do not call PhD mandatory.
records.context: Python/PyTorch OR JAX, VLA/video/large-transformer experience; familiarity with MuJoCo/Isaac/Drake. Education extractor also falsely includes technical-stack and experience bullets.
records.output: Research-to-production robot learning for high-DOF manipulation, multimodal foundation models and world modeling; evaluate on physical fleet in customer environments.

records.title: Senior Research Engineer, Humanoid Manipulation
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: Bachelor’s, Master’s OR PhD in a related field; 2+ years of manipulation/robot-learning experience in academia OR industry.
records.context: Kinematics/dynamics/control; RL and imitation learning; PyTorch; reproducible training/evaluation; real-hardware evidence. Publications OR open-source contributions are extras, not a mandatory PhD/publication requirement.
records.output: Develop and evaluate humanoid manipulation and locomotion-plus-manipulation models; integrate data and training systems with hardware tests, deployment and field feedback.

records.title: Reinforcement Learning Engineer, Whole Body Control
records.reviewMethod: Selected full-source contextual audit; does not change original cohort review status.
records.education: No explicit degree credential in this saved source. Requirements emphasize dynamics/control, robotics RL and leading complex controls work; do not infer degree-free entry level.
records.context: PPO/SAC, hyperparameter and cost tuning, randomization, curriculum and reward shaping. Behavior cloning is a bonus. The salary sentence was incorrectly classified as an experience clause.
records.output: Train, deploy and evaluate humanoid whole-body RL, choose observation/action/model spaces, close sim-to-real gaps and harden the control stack.

records.title: Robot Learning Engineer

records.title: Robot Learning Engineer
